name: MedStation

With Google Ads generating zero spend or conversions and GHL data unavailable, all 121 leads (28d CPL: $9.64) are attributable solely to Meta.

performance.verdict: CPL collapse is structural, not cyclical — SOW blockers are the root cause.

findings.text: 10 of 10 OVERDUE MILESTONES missed by up to 79 days: Meta CAPI, GHL migration, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, stack test — all undelivered as of 2026-10-18.
CPL spiked 47.37% week-over-week while spend rose only 7.18%; last-3-day lead average is 2.7 vs prior-3-day average of 3.0 — decline is holding, not recovering.
Single campaign MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $1,108.29 of $1,166.35 (95%) in 28 days; flat/rising spend with falling leads signals creative fatigue, not audience expansion.
GBP actions fell 50% week-over-week and hit 0 for the last 4 days (Oct 14–17); 65 directions + 9 calls in 28d show organic demand exists but is now dark.
GHL pipeline is null and GA4 shows 0 conversions across 1,848 sessions; 121 Meta leads have no verified downstream path — intake leak cannot be ruled out.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; no paid scale is defensible until stack test clears.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 Phase 1 milestones are overdue by up to 79 days as of 2026-10-18, including Meta CAPI, GHL migration, landing pages, and search campaigns. No further ad budget increases are defensible until the end-to-end stack test (due 2026-07-31) is completed and verified. Success check: stack test confirmed live with leads tracked through to GHL/NextGen EHR by 2026-10-25. Sohib to align with Nacer and Mateus on a hard completion date this week.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new creative variant into MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; campaign is 95% of spend with CPL up 47.37%.
suggestions.monday_update: MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP has consumed $1,108.29 (95% of total spend) while CPL rose 47.37% week-over-week and leads dropped 27.27% — a classic fatigue signature. Launch at least one new creative variant into the existing campaign without increasing budget. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $9.64 within 7 days of the new creative going live. Re-evaluate by 2026-10-25.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline and GA4 conversions; if both remain null/zero by 2026-10-21, escalate as confirmed intake leak.
